Catalogs Managed by the Buyer Organization
Reasons a buyer org might manage catalog content:
• The supplier does not maintain catalogs.
• Items provided by the supp lier to that particular buyer are not available in the catalog.
• The customer wants to present more information to users than what the supplier provides.
• The customer wants to get a large number of suppliers online very quickly.
• The supplier manages an item master in their ERP.

paragraphs: 1. Begins when the requisition is submitted at checkout.
2. It passes through workflow steps , each of which contain a trigger .
• What budget they are spending against
• Which contract or form they are buying from
1. Begins when the requisition is submitted at checkout.
2. It passes through workflow steps , each of which contain a trigger
3. When the requisition meets the criteria of a step, it triggers an action and then moves on to the next step in the workflow.
4. Upon the last approval, the purchase order is created.
• User approval : the system stops for approval/rejection from a user named in a designated folder
• System approval : the system stops for approval/rejection from the ERP
• Notification : the system notifies users in a designated folder
• System action : the system runs an internal program (robot)
